name: Worry And Stress
overview: Scripture teaches believers to place their full trust in the Lord rather than relying on their own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 exhorts. God reassures His people not to fear or be dismayed because He is present to strengthen, help, and uphold them (Isaiah 41:10). Jesus encourages His followers to release anxiety about daily needs and the future, emphasizing that each day has enough trouble of its own (Matthew 6:25, 6:34). He invites those burdened by worries to come to Him for rest (Matthew 11:28), offering a peace unlike that of the world, which calms troubled hearts and dispels fear (John 14:27).
